title: Search a pane's scrollback
notes: Cmd+F on macOS opens a small search box at the top of the focused pane; Enter and Shift+Enter jump between matches, Escape closes. Uses the xterm.js search addon. The box gets dir=auto, the key is a row in the actions table, and the help dialog gets the row. Cmd rather than Ctrl because Ctrl+F is the shell's forward-char.
